name: The Stranger
source:
Heir to an empty peerage title, bankrupt estate, and tarnished legacy. 

The Stranger (he/him) is a failed inductee into the prestigious University's Science Scholars Society. Intensely covetous of not just the Painter's love, body, and soul, but also his academic genius, wealth, and family name. 

An obsessed man walking, entirely unaware of the fate that awaits him when he opens the Painter's door.

"I love when you’re like this… when you need me."

[From [url=https://bloody-thy-end.itch.io/the-aching-maw]itch.io[/url]]
